content.title: The Danger of Seeking Comfort Outside of God
content.speaker: Pastor Mayowa John

content.title: When Life Hurts, Let God Be Your Comfort
Oh God, Comfort Me
content.text: Oh God, when life becomes painful, help me not to run away from You in search of comfort. Teach me to trust You, seek You and remain with You even when I do not understand what I am going through. Be my refuge, strengthen my heart, guide my decisions and help me find lasting comfort in You. In Jesus' name, Amen.
